notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware run was made and the sim backend was not run. The package serves the registered legacy Gym environment CartPoleDiscreteBalancing-Gazebo-v0 only: the other three registered identifiers (Pendulum-Gazebo-v0, CartPoleContinuousBalancing-Gazebo-v0, CartPoleContinuousSwingup-Gazebo-v0) share the same native GazeboRuntime entry point but are not served by this driver. Ignition Gazebo, ScenARIO and gym_ignition_models are not installed where the gate runs, so the fake backend is the package's own analytic stand-in (fake.py), its numeric constants are gate test data marked '# placeholder', and it was never compared with an Ignition Gazebo run. Fidelity is declared F0 with gaps, not F1, because the upstream rigid-body model was not run; engine 'gazebo' names the upstream environment the driver is for. The expected warnings are G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only arms the next reset) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the integer inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.index and seed twice). Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest line of the last passing run.
